# Penggunaan Material Ramah Lingkungan
## Use of Environmentally Friendly Materials
[OJK F.5]

Kesadaran Perseroan mendorong penggunaan material ramah lingkungan dalam rantai bisnisnya tidak hanya sebagai bagian dari upaya untuk mengurangi isu-isu lingkungan hidup. Namun lebih jauh dari itu, himbauan untuk menggunakan material ramah lingkungan di seluruh entitas di bawah Grup SCM juga bertujuan untuk meningkatkan efisiensi yang tidak hanya akan berdampak positif pada finansial perusahaan namun juga berdampak pada daya saing perusahaan.

Salah satu inisiatif yang terkait dengan kebijakan tersebut adalah himbauan untuk mengurangi penggunaan kertas dalam aktivitas sehari-hari (paperless), seperti untuk keperluan mencetak dokumen ataupun proses pembayaran/penagihan di divisi keuangan. Sebaliknya Perseroan menghimbau penggunaan surat elektronik untuk mendukung komunikasi ataupun keperluan surat-menyurat dalam kegiatan operasional sehari-hari di lingkup internal maupun saat berhubungan dengan mitra atau klien perusahaan, yang tentunya lebih efisien dalam waktu dan biaya pengirimannya karena tidak perlu menggunakan jasa kurir untuk mengirimkan dokumen.

Melalui kebijakan penggunaan material ramah lingkungan ini, Perseroan tidak hanya menciptakan kenyamanan melalui proses bisnis yang lebih efektif dan efisien melainkan juga turut berkontribusi pada pengurangan isu-isu lingkungan hidup, baik yang ditimbulkan dari limbah kertas yang dihasilkan dari kegiatan bisnisnya maupun dari sumber untuk menghasilkan material kertas itu sendiri.

Di samping himbauan pengurangan penggunaan kertas, kami juga menghimbau agar karyawan mengurangi penggunaan plastik yang termasuk dalam material yang sulit diuraikan (non biodegradable). Sebaliknya Perseroan menghimbau penggunaan wadah makan/minuman dari material yang ramah lingkungan atau kemasan non-plastik guna mengurangi limbah plastik yang dihasilkan dari kegiatan bisnis sehari-hari.

# Penggunaan Energi dan Pengendalian Emisi
## Energy Usage and Emission Control

### Pendekatan Manajemen

Secara umum kegiatan pengelolaan energi di lingkungan Perseroan bertujuan untuk mencapai penghematan konsumsi energi secara berkelanjutan. Manajemen Perseroan dalam hal ini telah menetapkan kebijakan efisiensi penggunaan energi yang berasal dari listrik, air maupun bahan bakar dan berupaya mencari teknologi yang sesuai dan dapat berdampak pada

The Company's awareness to encourage the use of environmentally friendly materials in its business chain is not only part of its efforts to reduce environmental issues. Furthermore, the urge to use environmentally friendly materials in all entities under the SCM Group also aims to improve efficiency which will not only have a positive impact on the Company's finances but also on the Company's competitiveness.

One of the initiatives related to this policy is the call to reduce the use of paper in daily activities (paperless), such as for printing documents or payment/billing processes in the finance division. Instead, the Company encourages the use of electronic mail to support communication or correspondence needs in daily operational activities within the internal scope as well as when dealing with partners or clients, which is certainly more efficient in time and shipping costs since there is no need to use courier services to send documents.

Through this policy of utilizing environmentally friendly materials, the Company not only creates convenience through more effective and efficient business processes but also contributes to the reduction of environmental issues, including from paper waste generated from its business activities and from the source to produce the paper material itself.

In addition to the call to reduce the use of paper, we also urge employees to reduce the use of plastic which is included in non-biodegradable materials. Instead, the Company encourages the use of food/drink containers made from environmentally friendly materials or non-plastic packaging to reduce plastic waste generated from daily business activities.

### Management's Approach

In general, energy management in the Company aims to achieve sustainable energy consumption. In this case, the Company's management has established a policy of efficient use of energy originating from electricity, water and fuel and seeks appropriate technology that can affect energy consumption. # Limbah yang Dikelola

## Waste Managed

[GRI 306-1] [OJK F.13, F.14]

Perseroan memahami bahwa kegiatan operasional yang dijalankan menghasilkan limbah dalam bentuk limbah organik maupun limbah non-organik. Oleh karenanya, untuk meminimalisir isu lingkungan, dibutuhkan pengelolaan limbah secara benar dan sesuai peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku. Limbah organik dan non-organik yang dihasilkan dari kegiatan operasi terdiri dari kertas, kardus, daun, kayu, sisa makanan serta botol minuman dan plastik. Perseroan dalam hal ini tidak menghasilkan limbah B3 (bahan berbahaya dan beracun) dari kegiatan operasinya. Kemudian, terhadap pengelolaan atas seluruh limbah padat non-B3 tersebut, Perseroan telah membuat kebijakan untuk menggunakan metode 3R; reduce (mengurangi), reuse (memanfaatkan kembali), dan recycle (daur ulang). Sementara itu, sampah domestik lainnya yang tidak terkelola diserahkan kepada pihak ketiga dan Tempat Penampungan Sementara (TPS). Perseroan juga bekerja sama dengan pihak unit pemeliharaan gedung dalam pengelolaan limbah tersebut.

Pada tahun 2023, Perseroan menghitung total limbah organik dan non organik yang dihasilkan dari kegiatan operasi mencapai 14.429 kg, dibandingkan jumlah tahun 2022 sebesar 26.837 kg.

The Company understands that its operational activities generate both organic and non-organic waste. Therefore, to minimize environmental issues, it is necessary to manage waste properly and in accordance with applicable laws and regulations. Organic and non-organic waste generated from operational activities consists of paper, cardboard, leaves, wood, food waste as well as beverage bottles and plastic. The Company in this case does not produce B3 (hazardous and toxic) waste from its operations. Then, for the management of all non-B3 solid waste, the Company has established a policy to use the 3R method; reduce, reuse, and recycle. Meanwhile, the rest of unmanaged domestic waste is handed over to third parties and temporary disposal sites (TPS). The Company also cooperates with the building maintenance unit to manage the waste.

In 2023, the Company calculates that the total organic and non-organic waste generated from its operations reached 14,429 kg, compared to 26,837 kg in 2022.

## Pengelolaan Air Limbah (Efluen)

Selain mengelola limbah padat, SCM juga mengelola air limbah yang dihasilkan dari kegiatan operasi. Air limbah yang dihasilkan Perseroan tidak dikategorikan limbah yang berbahaya. Namun demikian, untuk meminimalisir isu lingkungan, Perseroan dalam hal ini telah memiliki Instalasi Pengolahan Air Limbah (IPAL) di kantor Daan Mogot yang berfungsi untuk mengolah limbah air untuk kemudian dimanfaatkan kembali untuk menyiram tanaman di area kantor. ## Water (Effluent) Management

In addition to manage solid waste, SCM also manages wastewater generated from its operations. The wastewater generated by the Company is not categorized as hazardous waste. However, to minimize environmental issues, the Company has a Waste Water Treatment Plant (WWTP) in Daan Mogot office that treats waste water to be reused for watering plants in the office area. This initiative helps the Company to manage the use of clean water in the office environment.

In 2023, there were no significant wastewater spills since all wastewater can be processed and reused for the Company's domestic needs. [GRI 306-1, 306-2, 306-3] [OJK F.15]

# Dukungan terhadap Pelestarian Keanekaragaman Hayati
Support for Biodiversity Preservation
[OJK F.9, F.10]

Menilik karakteristik bisnisnya, kegiatan operasional SCM tidak terkait secara langsung dengan sumber daya alam. Lokasi usaha Perseroan terletak di area yang bukan merupakan kawasan konservasi atau kawasan dengan tingkat keanekaragaman hayati yang tinggi.

Namun demikian, SCM memberikan perhatian dan dukungan terhadap upaya pelestarian keanekaragaman hayati dalam kapasitasnya sebagai perusahaan yang bergerak di industri penyiaran, baik dalam bentuk konten atau program yang bersifat informatif maupun edukatif yang bertujuan mengajak masyarakat luas untuk mendukung upaya pelestarian lingkungan.

Selain itu, Perseroan juga melakukan penanaman hutan bakau dalam rangka mendukung upaya perlindungan terhadap ekosistem di sekitar hutan bakau yang merupakan habitat dari flora dan fauna tertentu.

# Biaya Lingkungan Hidup
Environmental Costs
[OJK F.4]

Untuk mendukung berbagai kegiatan terkait pelestarian lingkungan tersebut, Perseroan telah mengeluarkan biaya sebesar Rp4,91 miliar.

# Kepatuhan kepada Lingkungan
Environmental Compliance
[GRI 2-27] [OJK F.15, F.16]

Sebagai wujud kepatuhan terhadap lingkungan, Perseroan di antaranya telah memiliki izin untuk penggunaan sumber daya energi, di antaranya perizinan untuk pengambilan air yang diterbitkan oleh pihak institusi/regulator terkait, yaitu dalam bentuk Surat Izin Pengambilan Air Tanah (SIPA).

Sepanjang tahun 2023, tidak terdapat tumpahan limbah atau pengaduan terkait adanya polusi atau pencemaran lingkungan akibat kegiatan operasional Perseroan.

# Pengelolaan Pengaduan terkait Linkungan Hidup
Management of Environmental Complaints

Perseroan membuka kesempatan kepada masyarakat yang ingin menyampaikan laporan atau pengaduan terkait isu lingkungan hidup yang mungkin ditimbulkan dari kegiatan operasi Perseroan. Pada tahun 2023, kami tidak menerima pengaduan terkait lingkungan hidup dari pemangku kepentingan kami.

Given the nature of its business, SCM's operational activities are not directly related to natural resources. The Company's business sites are not located in conservation areas or in areas that have high levels of biodiversity.

Nevertheless, SCM pays attention and supports biodiversity conservation efforts in its capacity as a company that engages in the broadcasting industry, both in the form of informative and educative content or programs aimed at inviting the wider community to support environmental conservation efforts.

In addition, the Company also planted mangrove forests in order to support the efforts to protect the ecosystem around mangrove forests which are the habitat of certain flora and fauna.

To support various activities related to environmental conservation, the Company has incurred costs of Rp4.91 billion.

As a form of compliance with the environment, the Company has obtained permits to use energy resources, including permits for water withdrawal issued by the relevant institutions/regulators, in the form of a Groundwater Extraction Permit (SIPA).

Throughout 2023, there were no waste spills or complaints related to pollution or environmental pollution caused by the Company's operational activities.

The Company is always open to any reports on environmental issues that potentially emerge from the Company's operations. In 2023, we did not accept environmental complaints from our stakeholders.

Management's Approach

# Ketenagakerjaan

## Employment

[GRI 404-3]

Perseroan menunjuk Divisi Human Resources untuk menjalankan tanggung jawab pengelolaan dan pengembangan kompetensi SDM. Divisi ini menyampaikan laporan pengelolaan SDM kepada Direksi untuk kemudian menjadi bahan pertimbangan dalam menetapkan kebijakan pengelolaan SDM. Kinerja SDM Perseroan dievaluasi oleh Direksi dengan menggunakan kriteria yang dimasukkan ke dalam key performance indicators (KPI). Pada tahun 2023, Perseroan memastikan seluruh karyawan telah memperoleh tinjauan kinerja dan mengikuti seluruh kegiatan pengembangan karier yang direncanakan oleh Perseroan.

agreed with employees and prepared in accordance with the prevailing laws and regulations. The Company Regulation has been socialized to all employees and can be easily accessed on all company platforms.

In addition, a non-discriminatory policy is also adopted in managing relations with the community, especially during the recruitment of new employees. The Company applies the principles of equality, diversity, and compliance with various applicable regulations in the labor recruitment process.

The Company also aired Public Service Announcement (PSA) freely to support the government's programs by airing more than 30 PSA versions, including TV Digital PSA, Ministry of Woman Empowerment and Children Protection PSA, Film and Censorship Institution PSA, Ministry of Environment PSA with total broadcast nearly 20,000 spots and also in the Non-Time Consuming (NTC) format more than 110,000 times.

The Company appoints the Human Resources Division to be responsible for the management and development of HR competencies. This division submits HR management reports to the Board of Directors to be used as consideration in determining HR management policies. The Company's HR performance is evaluated by the Board of Directors using criteria that are incorporated into key performance indicators (KPIs). In 2023, the Company ensures that all employees have received performance reviews and participated in all career development programs planned by the Company.

# Kesetaraan dalam Bekerja

## Equality at Work

[GRI 401-1] [OJK F.18] [SASB] SV-ME-260A.1 [GRI 413-1] [GRI 405-1]

Dalam rangka memenuhi kebutuhan tenaga kerja yang kompeten, Perseroan melakukan proses rekrutmen secara adil, transparan dan tanpa membedakan ras, suku, agama, golongan, gender, warna kulit, afiliasi politik maupun kondisi fisik. Perseroan bahkan berkomitmen untuk menjunjung tinggi keberagaman, termasuk dengan memberikan kesempatan yang setara kepada karyawan laki-laki dan perempuan untuk mengembangkan kariernya, termasuk dengan menduduki jabatan struktural di organisasi Perseroan. Hingga per tanggal 31 Desember 2023, terdapat 4 (empat) orang perempuan yang menduduki jabatan anggota dewan Perseroan, di mana komposisi Direktur laki-laki dan perempuan pada jajaran manajemen adalah sama, yaitu masing-masing tiga orang (50%).

In order to fulfill the needs of a competent workforce, the Company conducts a recruitment process fairly, transparently and without distinguishing race, ethnicity, religion, class, gender, skin color, political affiliation or physical condition. The Company is also committed to uphold diversity, including by providing equal opportunities for male and female employees to develop their careers, as well as to serve in structural positions in the Company's organization. As of December 31, 2023, there are 4 (four) women who occupy the position of board members of the Company, in which the composition of male and female Directors in the management ranks is equal at three people each (50%).

Kinerja Keberlanjutan
Sustainability Performance

Selain itu, di tahun yang sama, Perseroan telah memberikan kesempatan kerja setara terhadap 14 karyawan berkebutuhan khusus yang ditempatkan di Divisi SCM Media sebanyak 12 orang dan di Divisi SCM Digital & Other Business sebanyak 2 orang. Di samping itu, Perseroan juga berkomitmen bahwa proses rekrutmen karyawan dilakukan secara terbuka untuk karyawan yang termasuk dalam rentang usia produktif namun Perseroan tidak memberlakukan perekrutan pekerja anak dan tidak ada praktik kerja paksa dalam kegiatan operasi SCM sebagaimana diatur dalam UU Ketenagakerjaan. Perseroan telah menerapkan aturan mengenai jam kerja karyawan sesuai ketentuan dalam Peraturan Perusahaan pasal 26 dan 29 yang telah diselaraskan dengan UU tenaga kerja dan sudah didaftarkan pada Kementerian Ketenagakerjaan Republik Indonesia. Perseroan juga memastikan kepatuhan terhadap Peraturan Pemerintah [PP] Pasal 21, 22, 26, 27, dan 28.

Melalui kebijakan kesetaraan dalam kesempatan kerja ini, Perseroan berharap secara tidak langsung berkontribusi untuk meningkatkan kesejahteraan masyarakat di lingkungan usaha Perseroan.

Selain itu, kebijakan kesetaraan tersebut juga diterapkan pada karyawan dan jajaran manajemen pada saat menentukan promosi, mutasi ataupun rotasi, yaitu Perseroan memberikan kesempatan yang adil dan setara bagi setiap pihak yang dapat memenuhi keahlian yang dibutuhkan Perseroan untuk mengembangkan kariernya tanpa membedakan jenis kelaminnya. Pada tahun 2023, Perseroan memberikan promosi kepada 201 karyawan dari Divisi SCM Media maupun Divisi SCM Digital & Other Business, yang terdiri dari 134 karyawan laki-laki dan 67 karyawan perempuan.

Kemudian, meskipun memberikan prioritas pada tenaga kerja lokal, Perseroan juga membuka kesempatan untuk tenaga kerja asing yang ingin mengembangkan kariernya di Perseroan. Pada tahun 2023, Perseroan tercatat mempekerjakan sebanyak 8 tenaga kerja asing yang berasal dari beberapa negara berbeda dengan penempatan di Divisi SCM Digital & Other Business. Jumlah tersebut mengalami kenaikan dibandingkan dengan 7 orang tenaga kerja asing yang dipekerjakan pada tahun 2022.

In the same year, the Company has provided equal employment opportunities to 14 employees with special needs who were assigned to SCM Media Division as many as 12 people and in SCM Digital & Other Business Division as many as 2 people. In addition, the Company is also committed to ensure that the employee recruitment process is open to employees who are in the productive age range, but the Company does not employ children and there are no forced labor practices in SCM operations as stipulated in the Labor Law. The Company has enforced the rules regarding employee working hours as stipulated in the Company Regulations article 26 and 29 which have been aligned with the labor law and have been registered with the Ministry of Manpower of the Republic of Indonesia. The Company also ensures compliance with Government Regulations [PP] Articles 21, 22, 26, 27, and 28.

Through this policy of equality in employment opportunities, the Company hopes to indirectly contribute to improving the welfare of the community in the Company's business environment.

In addition, the equality policy is also applied to employees and management ranks when determining promotions, transfers or rotations, in which the Company provides fair and equal opportunities for every party who possesses the skills required by the Company to develop their careers regardless of their gender. In 2023, the Company promoted 201 employees from SCM Media Division and SCM Digital & Other Business Division, consisting of 134 male employees and 67 female employees.

Despite giving priority to local employees, the Company also opens opportunities for foreign employees who wish to develop their careers in the Company. In 2023, the Company employed a total of 8 foreign workers from several different countries assigned to SCM Digital & Other Business Division. This number has increased compared to the 7 foreign workers employed in 2022.

## Perlindungan Hak Asasi Manusia

### Protection of Human Rights

**[OJK F.19, [GRI 406-1] [GRI 408-1] [GRI 409-1]**

Komitmen Perseroan untuk menerapkan prinsip-prinsip HAM dalam kegiatan operasional, terutama dalam mengelola hubungan dengan karyawan, merupakan salah satu bentuk kepatuhan terhadap peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku, di antaranya Undang-Undang RI No. 13 Tahun 2003 tentang Ketenagakerjaan.

Sebagai wujud penghormatan terhadap prinsip-prinsip HAM, maka kami telah menegakkan prinsip-prinsip yang berlaku universal dalam pengelolaan organisasi SCM. Salah satunya adalah penegakan prinsip independensi dalam pelaksanaan penilaian kinerja secara mandiri dan dalam pengambilan keputusan oleh badan eksekutif yang bertanggung jawab terhadap penerapan tata kelola perusahaan maupun kebijakan keberlanjutan. Kami juga menerapkan aspek keberagaman pada komposisi Direksi dan Dewan Komisaris yang merupakan organ utama pendukung pelaksanaan tata kelola keberlanjutan, yang mencakup keberagaman latar belakang pendidikan, usia, pengalaman hingga jenis kelamin. Hingga per tanggal 31 Desember 2023, kami memiliki 4 (empat) karyawan perempuan yang menduduki jabatan manajemen senior Perseroan atau sekitar $40\%$ dari total anggota manajemen senior. Keberagaman pada komposisi manajemen senior ini telah mendapat persetujuan dari pemegang saham yang dilakukan melalui proses penunjukan yang transparan sehingga dianggap dapat mewakili kepentingan perusahaan secara umum. Selain itu kami tidak mempekerjakan pekerja anak (child labor) ataupun kerja paksa (forced labor) yang bertentangan dengan prinsip HAM.

The Company's commitment to apply human rights principles in its operational activities, especially in managing relationships with employees, is a form of compliance with the prevailing laws and regulations, including the Law of the Republic of Indonesia No. 13 Year 2003 on Manpower.

As a form of our respect for human rights principles, we have enforced the universal principles in the management of SCM's organization. One of them is the principle of independency in the implementation of independent performance appraisal and decision making by the executive body responsible for the implementation of corporate governance and sustainability policies. We also apply diversity in the composition of the Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners, which are the main organs supporting the implementation of sustainability governance, including diversity in educational background, age, experience and gender. As of December 31, 2023, we have 4 (four) female employees who hold senior management positions in the Company or approximately $40\%$ of the total senior management members. This diverse senior management composition has been approved by the Shareholders through a transparent appointment process so that can be regarded as representing the interests of the company in general. We also do not employ child labor or forced labor practices that against human rights principle.

## Perjanjian Kerja Bersama (PKB)

### Collective Labor Agreement (CLA)

**[GRI 2-30] [GRI 406-1] [GRI 408-1] [GRI 409-1]**

Selain menerbitkan Peraturan Perusahaan, Perseroan juga mengatur mengenai hak dan kewajiban karyawan melalui Perjanjian Kerja Bersama (PKB) yang disepakati pada awal rekrutmen karyawan. Penerbitan PKB menjadi salah satu dokumen yang mewakili komitmen Perseroan untuk tidak menerapkan praktik diskriminasi terhadap karyawan. Pada tahun 2023, Perseroan memastikan tidak ada praktik-praktik diskriminasi dalam pengelolaan hubungan dengan karyawan, termasuk dengan memberikan kesempatan kepada karyawan untuk menjalankan ibadah sesuai keyakinan masing-masing.

In addition to issuing Company Regulations, the Company also regulates the rights and obligations of employees through Collective Labor Agreements (CLAs) which are agreed upon at the beginning of employee recruitment. The issuance of the CLA is one of the documents that represent the Company's commitment to avoid discriminatory practices against employees. In 2023, the Company ensures that there are no discriminatory practices in the management of relationships with employees, including by providing opportunities for employees to worship according to their respective beliefs.

Sustainability Performance

Kemudian sebagai bagian dari pengelolaan hubungan industri, SCM juga menjamin kebebasan berserikat dan berkumpul bagi karyawan. Keberadaan serikat pekerja ini sekaligus mewadahi aspirasi seluruh karyawan dan menjadi penghubung antara karyawan dan manajemen, termasuk dalam rangka sosialisasi kebijakan baru Perseroan. Komitmen ini sejalan dengan dengan UUD 1945 Pasal 28E, serta memenuhi Ketentuan Ketenagakerjaan 104, Pasal 1 (UU No. 13/2003), dan Ketentuan Serikat Pekerja Pasal 29 (UU No. 21/2000) maupun ketentuan terkait perlindungan hak asasi manusia yang diatur dalam International Bill of Human Rights.

## Kesejahteraan Karyawan

### Employee Welfare

[GRI 201-1] [GRI 405-2] [GRI 401-3] [OJK F.20]

Sebagai wujud apresiasi terhadap kinerja karyawan sekaligus sebagai upaya retensi karyawan, maka SCM juga memberikan remunerasi yang menarik disertai sejumlah tunjangan dan fasilitas. Kebijakan Perseroan dalam memberikan tunjangan dan fasilitas pendukung bagi karyawan menggunakan pendekatan kebijakan equal pay for equal work, yang mana Perseroan memiliki kebijakan untuk memberikan upah dan remunerasi sesuai dengan keahlian, masa kerja, dan kebutuhan serta tanpa membedakan antara laki-laki dengan perempuan. Perseroan juga mengikutsertakan karyawan pada program jaminan sosial ketenagakerjaan dan jaminan sosial kesehatan sehingga menciptakan rasa aman dan nyaman saat bekerja.

Dalam merumuskan remunerasi bagi karyawan, Perseroan juga berkomitmen untuk memenuhi peraturan tentang upah minimum yang diterapkan oleh pemerintah setempat. Pada tahun 2023, rasio remunerasi bagi pekerja entry level terhadap rasio upah minimum yang berlaku di Provinsi DKI Jakarta dan Peraturan Perusahaan Pasal 15 adalah 1:1 atau dengan kata lain setara dengan ketentuan upah minimum yang ditetapkan.

Di samping remunerasi dan tunjangan yang diberikan setiap bulan kepada karyawan, Perseroan juga menerbitkan kebijakan kepemilikan saham untuk manajemen atau karyawan tertentu yang memenuhi ketentuan (Management Employee Stock Option Program/MESOP) dan beberapa entitas anak Perseroan.

As part of industrial relations management, SCM also guarantees freedom of association and assembly for employees. The existence of this labor union also accommodates the aspirations of all employees and serves as a liaison between employees and management, including in the socialization of new policies of the Company. This commitment is in line with the 1945 Constitution Article 28E, as well as fulfilling the provisions of Labor Law 104, Article 1 (Law No. 13/2003), and the provisions of Labor Unions Article 29 (Law No. 21/2000), including provisions related to the protection of human rights stipulated in the International Bill of Human Rights.

As a form of appreciation for employee performance as well as employee retention efforts, SCM also provides attractive remuneration along with a number of benefits and facilities. The Company's policy in providing benefits and supporting facilities for employees is based on the equal pay for equal work policy approach, in which the Company has a policy to provide wages and remuneration in accordance with skills, length of service, and needs, regardless of their gender. The Company also enrolls employees in the employment social security and health social security programs so as to create a sense of security and comfort while working.

In formulating remuneration for employees, the Company is also committed to meeting the minimum wage regulations implemented by the local government. In 2023, the ratio of remuneration for entry level workers to the ratio of the minimum wage applicable in DKI Jakarta Province and Company Regulation Article 15 is 1:1 or equivalent to the stipulated minimum wage.

In addition to the monthly remuneration and benefits provided to employees, the Company also issues a share ownership program for management or certain employees who are qualified. (Management Employee Stock Option Program/MESOP) and some of the Company's subsidiaries.

Lebih lanjut mengenai pemberian hak cuti melahirkan, cuti melahirkan diberikan untuk masa waktu 90 hari kalender bagi karyawan perempuan dan karyawan yang bersangkutan dapat kembali bekerja usai menjalani masa cuti. Hak cuti juga diberikan kepada karyawan laki-laki yang istrinya melahirkan (paternity leave) selama 2 hari kalender. Pada tahun 2023, sebanyak 48 karyawan perempuan mengambil cuti melahirkan, yang terdiri 19 orang karyawan dari Divisi SCM Media dan 29 orang karyawan dari Divisi SCM Digital & Other Business, dan seluruh karyawan tersebut telah kembali bekerja dengan penempatan posisi yang sama sebelum mereka mengambil cuti melahirkan.

Di samping remunerasi karyawan, Perseroan juga memberikan remunerasi yang menarik bagi anggota Direksi, Dewan Komisaris dan jajaran eksekutif, termasuk memberikan insentif jangka panjang sebagai bentuk apresiasi atas dedikasi jajaran manajemen dan karyawan. Komponen remunerasi bagi Direksi dan Dewan Komisaris telah dijelaskan pada Laporan Tahunan 2023 yang disajikan dalam dokumen terpisah.

Perseroan menunjukkan Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi untuk membantu merumuskan kebijakan remunerasi bagi Direksi dan Dewan Komisaris untuk kemudian diusulkan kepada Dewan Komisaris untuk dimintakan masukannya sebelum disampaikan kepada RUPS untuk dimintakan persetujuannya. Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi Perseroan ini dipimpin oleh Wakil Komisaris Utama dan Komisaris Independen Perseroan, Suryani Zaini. Informasi lebih lanjut mengenai Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi Perseroan, termasuk struktur keanggotaan dan lingkup tugas dan tanggung jawabnya, dapat dilihat pada Laporan Tahunan 2023 yang disajikan terpisah dari Laporan Keberlanjutan ini.

# Lingkungan Kerja yang Layak, Sehat, dan Aman
Decent, Healthy, and Safe Working Environment
[GRI 403-1] [GRI 403-5] [GRI 403-9] [OJK F.21]

Untuk mendorong karyawan agar terus berkarya dan bekerja secara produktif, SCM telah menyediakan lingkungan kerja yang layak, sehat dan aman melalui penerapan Kebijakan Kesehatan dan Keselamatan Kerja (K3).

Penerapan K3 di lingkungan Perseroan dilaksanakan antara lain dengan melaksanakan berbagai pelatihan terkait K3, seperti pelatihan evakuasi kebakaran gabungan, simulasi damkar kering, dan pelatihan penggunaan tabung apar. Hingga akhir tahun 2023, Perseroan memastikan pengelolaan K3 telah berjalan baik sebagaimana diindikasikan hanya ada 1 (satu) insiden kecelakaan kerja ringan.

As for the provision regarding maternity leave, it is given for a period of 90 calendar days for female employees and the employee concerned can return to work after their leave period. Leave rights are also given to male employees whose wives give birth (paternity leave) for 2 calendar days. In 2023, a total of 48 female employees took paternity leave, consisting of 19 employees from SCM Media Division and 29 employees from SCM Digital & Other Business Division, and all employees have returned to work in the same position before they took the leave.

In addition to employee remuneration, the Company also provides attractive remuneration for members of the Board of Directors, Board of Commissioners and executives, including long-term incentives as a form of appreciation for the dedication of the management and employees. The remuneration components for the Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners have been elaborated in the 2023 Annual Report which is presented in a separate document.

The Company appoints the Nomination and Remuneration Committee to assist the formulation of remuneration policies for the Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners to be proposed to the Board of Commissioners for input before being submitted to the GMS for approval. The Nomination and Remuneration Committee is chaired by the Vice President Commissioner and Independent Commissioner of the Company, Suryani Zaini. Further information on the Company's Nomination and Remuneration Committee, including its membership structure and scope of duties and responsibilities, can be found in the 2023 Annual Report which is presented separately from this Sustainability Report.

To encourage employees to continue working productively, SCM has provided a decent, healthy and safe working environment through the implementation of Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) policies.

The implementation of OHS in the Company's environment is carried out through various OHS-related trainings, such as joint fire evacuation training, dry firefighting simulation, and training on the use of light fire extinguishers. Until the end of 2023, the Company ensures that its OHS management has been running properly, as indicated there was only 1 (one) minor work accident.

Penerapan K3 di lingkungan Perseroan dilaksanakan antara lain dengan melaksanakan berbagai pelatihan terkait K3, seperti pelatihan evakuasi kebakaran gabungan, simulasi damkar kering, dan pelatihan penggunaan tabung apar.
Hingga akhir tahun 2023, Perseroan memastikan pengelolaan K3 telah berjalan baik sebagaimana diindikasikan hanya ada 1 (satu) insiden kecelakaan kerja ringan.
As for the provision regarding maternity leave, it is given for a period of 90 calendar days for female employees and the employee concerned can return to work after their leave period.
Leave rights are also given to male employees whose wives give birth (paternity leave) for 2 calendar days.
In 2023, a total of 48 female employees took paternity leave, consisting of 19 employees from SCM Media Division and 29 employees from SCM Digital &amp
Other Business Division, and all employees have returned to work in the same position before they took the leave.
In addition to employee remuneration, the Company also provides attractive remuneration for members of the Board of Directors, Board of Commissioners and executives, including long
term incentives as a form of appreciation for the dedication of the management and employees.
The remuneration components for the Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners have been elaborated in the 2023 Annual Report which is presented in a separate document.

The Company appoints the Nomination and Remuneration Committee to assist the formulation of remuneration policies for the Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners to be proposed to the Board of Commissioners for input before being submitted to the GMS for approval.
The Nomination and Remuneration Committee is chaired by the Vice President Commissioner and Independent Commissioner of the Company, Suryani Zaini.

Further information on the Company's Nomination and Remuneration Committee, including its membership structure and scope of duties and responsibilities, can be found in the 2023 Annual Report which is presented separately from this Sustainability Report.
To encourage employees to continue working productively, SCM has provided a decent, healthy and safe working environment through the implementation of Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) policies.
The implementation of OHS in the Company's environment is carried out through various OHS
related trainings, such as joint fire evacuation training, dry firefighting simulation, and training on the use of light fire extinguishers.
Until the end of 2023, the Company ensures that its OHS management has been running properly, as indicated there was only 1 (one) minor work accident.

Penjelasan Direksi
Board of Directors' Message

membagikan set-top-box secara gratis kepada masyarakat yang kurang mampu sebagai salah satu wujud pemenuhan komitmen keberlanjutan pada aspek sosial.

Strategi Perseroan yang senantiasa mendorong transformasi yang didukung oleh inovasi dan investasi secara berkelanjutan dinilai berhasil meningkatkan kinerja core business SCM untuk menjadi yang terdepan di jajaran televisi Free-To-Air (FTA) nasional. Secara keseluruhan, pada tahun 2023 seluruh televisi FTA milik Perseroan berhasil mencatatkan rata-rata audience share 34,9%, di mana SCTV memimpin dengan rata-rata audience share 14,3% sedangkan Indosiar meraih rata-rata audience share 13,0%. Sementara itu, Mentari TV berhasil menempatkan dirinya di posisi kelima dalam jajaran televisi FTA nasional dengan 7,6% rata-rata audience share. Kinerja TV FTA kami yang membanggkan itu menegaskan bahwa keberadaan TV FTA nasional ternyata masih paling diminati oleh pemirsa di tanah Air.

Prestasi Grup SCM yang cukup signifikan lainnya dicatatkan oleh platform Vidio. Kualitas konten maupun layanan Vidio dengan memanfaatkan Machine Learning Artificial Intelligence dan produksi Original Series-nya berhasil memposisikannya sebagai platform OTT paling popular dengan jumlah pemasangan pada Smart TV mencapai lebih dari 20 juta. Bahkan data Media Partner Asia (MPA) menunjukkan Vidio berhasil menyaingi kepopuleran pemain OTT global dan regional, seperti Netflix dan Disney+, dengan menduduki posisi ke-1, baik dalam hal jumlah Pengguna Aktif Bulanan (Monthly Active Users/MAU) di kawasan Asia Tenggara maupun jumlah durasi streaming pada kuartal III/2023. Pada kuartal IV/2023, Vidio mencapai posisi platform OTT No. 1 dalam hal jumlah pelanggan terbanyak di Indonesia.

Vidio juga dikenal dengan julukan "home of sports" melalui berbagai tayangan konten olahraga lokal seperti: BRI Liga 1, Proliga, Livoli, hingga konten olahraga internasional seperti: Premier League, NBA, UEFA Champions League, Serie A, La Liga, Olimpiade, FIFA World Cup Qatar 2023 hingga yang terbaru, yaitu penyelenggaraan FIFA U-17 World Cup 2023 di mana Indonesia untuk pertama kalinya dalam sejarah ditunjuk sebagai tuan rumah.

Lalu, pada lini usaha content production, Perseroan berhasil mencapai kinerja gemilang melalui penayangan drama mini seri produksi Base Entertainment, 'Gadis Kretek', dan drama berkualitas lain yang diproduksi oleh Sinemart dan Screenplay. 'Gadis Kretek' berhasil meraih posisi No. 1 di Netflix Indonesia dan masuk dalam jajaran Top-10 di empat negara lainnya.

Perseroan berhasil menyengkkan sejumlah event yang digagas bersama RANS Entertainment dengan kapabilitas yang dimiliki internal perusahaan untuk menarik minat para pengiklan. Salah satu program kompetisi hiburan olahraga selebritas Indonesia hasil kolaborasi SCTV dan RANS yang menjadi program unggulan dan mendapat sambutan hangat dari masyarakat adalah Turnamen Olahraga Selebriti Indonesia (TOSI). Turnamen yang melibatkan selebritas papan atas Indonesia itu memainkan empat cabang olahraga, yaitu bulu tangkis, tenis, tenis meja, dan atletik. Melihat animo masyarakat yang begitu besar, TOSI kembali digelar di tahun 2024 dengan mempertandingkan cabang olahraga baru, yakni renang.

Dampak operasional Perseroan yang berkelanjutan juga dapat dirasakan pada aspek sosial, dalam bentuk penyerapan tenaga kerja dari masyarakat sekitar lokasi usaha Perseroan

distributed free set-top-boxes to the underprivileged communities as one of the commitments to sustainability in the social aspect.

The Company's strategy that continues to drive transformation is supported by continuous innovation and investment, which has successfully increased SCM's core business performance to be at the forefront of the national Free-To-Air (FTA) television lineup. Overall, in 2023, all of the Company's FTA televisions recorded an average audience share of 34.9%, with SCTV leading with an average audience share of 14.3% while Indosiar achieved an average audience share of 13.0%. Meanwhile, Mentari TV managed to place itself in fifth position in the national FTA television lineup with 7.6% average audience share. The impressive performance of our FTA TV confirms that national FTA TV remains as the viewers' favourite in the country.

Another significant achievement of SCM Group was recorded by the Vidio platform. The quality of Vidio's content and services that utilize Machine Learning Artificial Intelligence and its Original Series production has positioned it as the most popular OTT platform with more than 20 million installations on Smart TVs. In fact, Media Partner Asia (MPA) data shows that Vidio managed to rival the popularity of global and regional OTT players, such as Netflix and Disney+ by occupying the top position, both in terms of the number of Monthly Active Users (MAU) in the Southeast Asia region and the number of streaming durations in the third quarter of 2023. In the fourth quarter of 2023, Vidio became the No. 1 OTT platform in terms of the highest number of subscribers in Indonesia.

Vidio is also known as the "home of sports" through various local sports content shows such as: BRI Liga 1, Proliga, Livoli, to international sports content such as: Premier League, NBA, UEFA Champions League, Serie A, La Liga, Olympics, FIFA World Cup Qatar 2023 and most recently, the FIFA U-17 World Cup 2023 where Indonesia was appointed as the host for the first time in history.

Then, in the content production business line, the Company managed to record a brilliant performance through the airing of a mini-series drama produced by Base Entertainment, 'Gadis Kretek', and other quality dramas produced by Sinemart and Screenplay. 'Gadis Kretek' secured the No. 1 position on Netflix Indonesia and entered the Top-10 in four other countries.

The Company successfully synergized a number of events in collaboration with RANS Entertainment and its internal capabilities to attract advertisers. One of the Indonesian celebrity sports entertainment competition programs resulting from the collaboration of SCTV and RANS, which has become a flagship program and received rave reviews from the public, is the Turnamen Olahraga Selebriti Indonesia (TOSI). The tournament involves Indonesia's top celebrities to play in four sports, including badminton, tennis, table tennis, and athletics. Seeing the immense public interest, TOSI will be held again in 2024 by adding a new sport, that is swimming.

The impact of the Company's sustainable operations can also be felt in the social aspect, in the form of absorption of labor from communities around the Company and its subsidiaries'

Kesetaraan kesempatan untuk memperoleh pekerjaan di Perseroan maupun di entitas anak ini merupakan wujud komitmen Perseroan terhadap perlindungan hak-hak manusia, terutama untuk memperoleh keselamatan dan kesejahteraan. Perseroan menjamin tersedianya lingkungan kerja yang layak dengan asuransi kesehatan dan peralatan kerja yang lengkap yang dapat memfasilitasi karyawan untuk bekerja secara produktif dan menunjukkan kreativitas mereka untuk mendukung kemajuan Perseroan. Aspek kesetaraan juga kami penuhi dengan memberikan kesempatan yang sama kepada karyawan perempuan untuk meraih jenjang karier yang tinggi pada jabatan struktural, dan hal ini telah dibuktikan dengan setaranya jumlah direksi wanita dengan pria yang berada dalam Direksi Perseroan.

Selain itu, Perseroan juga memberikan kesempatan kepada karyawan untuk mengikuti berbagai pelatihan dan sertifikasi yang dibutuhkan untuk menunjang pelaksanaan tugas dan tanggung jawab mereka. Peningkatan kompetensi karyawan ini diharapkan akan meningkatkan kapasitas dan kapabilitas organisasi dan pada akhirnya menjaga daya saing Perusahaan di masa datang.

Di samping manfaat yang dihasilkan dari jasa atau produk kami, Perseroan juga berkomitmen untuk meningkatkan partisipasinya dalam upaya-upaya untuk mengatasi berbagai isu sosial dan lingkungan yang terjadi di masyarakat. Kontribusi Perseroan salah satunya disalurkan melalui Yayasan Pundi Amal Peduli Kasih (YPP), di mana kami telah menyalurkan bantuan sosial bagi masyarakat yang membutuhkan. Bantuan tersebut berupa kegiatan terkait kesehatan, yaitu dalam bentuk donor darah, operasi katarak gratis bagi 2.615 pasien di 25 lokasi di Indonesia, pemberian paket makanan stunting dan sebagainya. Untuk kegiatan donor darah, kami bekerja sama dengan Palang Merah Indonesia di mana tahun ini kami berhasil mengumpulkan 8.105 kantong darah.

Kemudian, pemenuhan tanggung jawab kami dalam aspek sosial juga diwujudkan dengan memberikan perhatian yang besar terhadap dunia pendidikan. Kami memahami ketersediaan tenaga kerja di bidang media merupakan salah satu hal penting untuk menjaga keberlangsungan usaha Perseroan dan entitas anaknya. Untuk itu, melalui Akademi Televisi Indonesia (ATVI) yang merupakan sebuah lembaga pendidikan terakreditasi yang dimiliki Grup SCM, kami turut berperan dalam mempersiapkan tenaga profesional di bidang penyiaran sehingga dengan sendirinya akan menjamin ketersediaan tenaga kerja yang kompeten di bidang media ke depannya.

Selain itu, kami juga memberikan beasiswa bagi 12 mahasiswa dari berbagai universitas di Indonesia yang membutuhkan dukungan biaya akademik hingga akhirnya mereka dapat menyandang gelar sarjana. Lalu kami juga mengadakan kegiatan edukasi anti bullying di sejumlah wilayah di Indonesia, guna menekan kasus bullying yang marak terjadi di Indonesia.

Sementara itu, kami juga memberikan perhatian terhadap masalah-masalah lingkungan. Dalam rangka meningkatkan taraf hidup masyarakat, kami telah membangun dua jembatan yang terletak di Kelurahan Pasir Gunung Selatan, Depok, Jawa Barat, dan di Desa Sidodadi, Bojonegoro, Jawa Timur. Pembangunan jembatan ini diharapkan dapat meningkatkan aktivitas ekonomi masyarakat setempat.

Kami juga menyiarkan Iklan Layanan Masyarakat (ILM) secara gratis untuk membantu program-program Pemerintah dengan menayangkan lebih dari 30 versi ILM, termasuk ILM TV digital, business locations. The equal opportunity to obtain employment in the Company and its subsidiaries is a manifestation of the Company's commitment to protect human rights, especially in providing safety and welfare. The Company guarantees the availability of a decent working environment with health insurance and complete work equipment that can facilitate employees working productively and showing their creativity in supporting the Company's progress. We also fulfil the aspect of equality by providing equal opportunities to female employees to reach high career levels in structural positions, and this is proven with the equal amount of member between female and male in the Company's Board of Director.

In addition, the Company also provides opportunities for employees to participate in various trainings and certifications needed to support the implementation of their duties and responsibilities. The development of employee competencies is expected to increase the capacity and capability of the organization and ultimately maintain the Company's competitiveness in the future.

In addition to the benefits of our services or products, the Company is also committed to increasing its participation in addressing various social and environmental issues that occur in the community. One of the Company's contributions is channelled through Yayasan Pundi Amal Peduli Kasih (YPP) to distribute social assistance to communities in need. The assistance is in the form of health-related activities, including blood donation, free cataract surgery for 2,615 patients in 25 locations in Indonesia, provision of stunting food packages and so on. For blood donation programs, we collaborate with the Indonesian Red Cross and managed to collect 8,105 blood bags this year.

Moreover, the fulfilment of our responsibility in the social aspect is also realized by paying great attention to the education sector. We understand that the availability of workforce in the media sector is one of the key factors to maintain the sustainability of the Company and its subsidiaries. Therefore, through Akademi Televisi Indonesia (ATVI), an accredited educational institution owned by SCM Group, we contribute in preparing broadcasting professionals to ensure the availability of a competent workforce in the media sector in the future.

In addition, we also provided scholarships for 12 students from various universities in Indonesia who are in need of academic support so that they can obtain a bachelor's degree. We also held anti-bullying educational campaigns in a number of areas in Indonesia, in order to suppress bullying cases that are prevalent in the country.

In the meantime, we also pay attention to environmental issues. In order to improve people's lives, we have built two bridges located in Pasir Gunung Selatan Village, Depok, West Java, and in Sidodadi Village, Bojonegoro, East Java. The construction of these bridges is expected to improve the economic activities of the local communities.

We also aired Public Service Announcement (PSA) freely to support the government's programs by airing more than 30 PSA versions, including TV Digital PSA, Ministry of Woman

Strategi Perseroan yang senantiasa mendorong transformasi yang didukung oleh inovasi dan investasi secara berkelanjutan dinilai berhasil meningkatkan kinerja core business SCM untuk menjadi yang terdepan di jajaran televisi Free-To-Air (FTA) nasional. Secara keseluruhan, pada tahun 2023 seluruh televisi FTA milik Perseroan berhasil mencatatkan rata-rata audience share 34,9%, di mana SCTV memimpin dengan rata-rata audience share 14,3% sedangkan Indosiar meraih rata-rata audience share 13,0%. Sementara itu, Mentari TV berhasil menempatkan dirinya di posisi kelima dalam jajaran televisi FTA nasional dengan 7,6% rata-rata audience share. Kinerja TV FTA kami yang membanggkan itu menegaskan bahwa keberadaan TV FTA nasional ternyata masih paling diminati oleh pemirsa di tanah Air.

Prestasi Grup SCM yang cukup signifikan lainnya dicatatkan oleh platform Vidio. Bahkan data Media Partner Asia (MPA) menunjukkan Vidio berhasil menyaingi kepopuleran pemain OTT global dan regional, seperti Netflix dan Disney+, dengan menduduki posisi ke-1, baik dalam hal jumlah Pengguna Aktif Bulanan (Monthly Active Users/MAU) di kawasan Asia Tenggara maupun jumlah durasi streaming pada kuartal III/2023. Pada kuartal IV/2023, Vidio mencapai posisi platform OTT No. 1 dalam hal jumlah pelanggan terbanyak di Indonesia.

Vidio juga dikenal dengan julukan "home of sports" melalui berbagai tayangan konten olahraga lokal seperti: BRI Liga 1, Proliga, Livoli, hingga konten olahraga internasional seperti: Premier League, NBA, UEFA Champions League, Serie A, La Liga, Olimpiade, FIFA World Cup Qatar 2023 hingga yang terbaru, yaitu penyelenggaraan FIFA U-17 World Cup 2023 di mana Indonesia untuk pertama kalinya dalam sejarah ditunjuk sebagai tuan rumah.

distributed free set-top-boxes to the underprivileged communities as one of the commitments to sustainability in the social aspect.

dan entitas anak. Kesetaraan kesempatan untuk memperoleh pekerjaan di Perseroan maupun di entitas anak ini merupakan wujud komitmen Perseroan terhadap perlindungan hak-hak manusia, terutama untuk memperoleh keselamatan dan kesejahteraan. Perseroan menjamin tersedianya lingkungan kerja yang layak dengan asuransi kesehatan dan peralatan kerja yang lengkap yang dapat memfasilitasi karyawan untuk bekerja secara produktif dan menunjukkan kreativitas mereka untuk mendukung kemajuan Perseroan. Aspek kesetaraan juga kami penuhi dengan memberikan kesempatan yang sama kepada karyawan perempuan untuk meraih jenjang karier yang tinggi pada jabatan struktural, dan hal ini telah dibuktikan dengan setaranya jumlah direksi wanita dengan pria yang berada dalam Direksi Perseroan.

Selain itu, Perseroan juga memberikan kesempatan kepada karyawan untuk mengikuti berbagai pelatihan dan sertifikasi yang dibutuhkan untuk menunjang pelaksanaan tugas dan tanggung jawab mereka. Peningkatan kompetensi karyawan ini diharapkan akan meningkatkan kapasitas dan kapabilitas organisasi dan pada akhirnya menjaga daya saing Perusahaan di masa datang.

Di samping manfaat yang dihasilkan dari jasa atau produk kami, Perseroan juga berkomitmen untuk meningkatkan partisipasinya dalam upaya-upaya untuk mengatasi berbagai isu sosial dan lingkungan yang terjadi di masyarakat. Kontribusi Perseroan salah satunya disalurkan melalui Yayasan Pundi Amal Peduli Kasih (YPP), di mana kami telah menyalurkan bantuan sosial bagi masyarakat yang membutuhkan. Bantuan tersebut berupa kegiatan terkait kesehatan, yaitu dalam bentuk donor darah, operasi katarak gratis bagi 2.615 pasien di 25 lokasi di Indonesia, pemberian paket makanan stunting dan sebagainya. Untuk kegiatan donor darah, kami bekerja sama dengan Palang Merah Indonesia di mana tahun ini kami berhasil mengumpulkan 8.105 kantong darah.

Kemudian, pemenuhan tanggung jawab kami dalam aspek sosial juga diwujudkan dengan memberikan perhatian yang besar terhadap dunia pendidikan. Kami memahami ketersediaan tenaga kerja di bidang media merupakan salah satu hal penting untuk menjaga keberlangsungan usaha Perseroan dan entitas anaknya. Untuk itu, melalui Akademi Televisi Indonesia (ATVI) yang merupakan sebuah lembaga pendidikan terakreditasi yang dimiliki Grup SCM, kami turut berperan dalam mempersiapkan tenaga profesional di bidang penyiaran sehingga dengan sendirinya akan menjamin ketersediaan tenaga kerja yang kompeten di bidang media ke depannya.

Selain itu, kami juga memberikan beasiswa bagi 12 mahasiswa dari berbagai universitas di Indonesia yang membutuhkan dukungan biaya akademik hingga akhirnya mereka dapat menyandang gelar sarjana. Lalu kami juga mengadakan kegiatan edukasi anti bullying di sejumlah wilayah di Indonesia, guna menekan kasus bullying yang marak terjadi di Indonesia.

Sementara itu, kami juga memberikan perhatian terhadap masalah-masalah lingkungan. Dalam rangka meningkatkan taraf hidup masyarakat, kami telah membangun dua jembatan yang terletak di Kelurahan Pasir Gunung Selatan, Depok, Jawa Barat, dan di Desa Sidodadi, Bojonegoro, Jawa Timur. Pembangunan jembatan ini diharapkan dapat meningkatkan aktivitas ekonomi masyarakat setempat.

Kami juga menyiarkan Iklan Layanan Masyarakat (ILM) secara gratis untuk membantu program-program Pemerintah dengan menayangkan lebih dari 30 versi ILM, termasuk ILM TV digital, business locations. The equal opportunity to obtain employment in the Company and its subsidiaries is a manifestation of the Company's commitment to protect human rights, especially in providing safety and welfare. The Company guarantees the availability of a decent working environment with health insurance and complete work equipment that can facilitate employees working productively and showing their creativity in supporting the Company's progress. We also fulfil the aspect of equality by providing equal opportunities to female employees to reach high career levels in structural positions, and this is proven with the equal amount of member between female and male in the Company's Board of Director.

In addition, the Company also provides opportunities for employees to participate in various trainings and certifications needed to support the implementation of their duties and responsibilities. The development of employee competencies is expected to increase the capacity and capability of the organization and ultimately maintain the Company's competitiveness in the future.

In addition to the benefits of our services or products, the Company is also committed to increasing its participation in addressing various social and environmental issues that occur in the community. One of the Company's contributions is channelled through Yayasan Pundi Amal Peduli Kasih (YPP) to distribute social assistance to communities in need. The assistance is in the form of health-related activities, including blood donation, free cataract surgery for 2,615 patients in 25 locations in Indonesia, provision of stunting food packages and so on. For blood donation programs, we collaborate with the Indonesian Red Cross and managed to collect 8,105 blood bags this year.

Penjelasan Direksi
Board of Directors' Message

membagikan set-top-box secara gratis kepada masyarakat yang kurang mampu sebagai salah satu wujud pemenuhan komitmen keberlanjutan pada aspek sosial.

Strategi Perseroan yang senantiasa mendorong transformasi yang didukung oleh inovasi dan investasi secara berkelanjutan dinilai berhasil meningkatkan kinerja core business SCM untuk menjadi yang terdepan di jajaran televisi Free-To-Air (FTA) nasional. Secara keseluruhan, pada tahun 2023 seluruh televisi FTA milik Perseroan berhasil mencatatkan rata-rata audience share 34,9%, di mana SCTV memimpin dengan rata-rata audience share 14,3% sedangkan Indosiar meraih rata-rata audience share 13,0%. Sementara itu, Mentari TV berhasil menempatkan dirinya di posisi kelima dalam jajaran televisi FTA nasional dengan 7,6% rata-rata audience share. Kinerja TV FTA kami yang membanggkan itu menegaskan bahwa keberadaan TV FTA nasional ternyata masih paling diminati oleh pemirsa di tanah Air.

Prestasi Grup SCM yang cukup signifikan lainnya dicatatkan oleh platform Vidio. Kualitas konten maupun layanan Vidio dengan memanfaatkan Machine Learning Artificial Intelligence dan produksi Original Series-nya berhasil memposisikannya sebagai platform OTT paling popular dengan jumlah pemasangan pada Smart TV mencapai lebih dari 20 juta. Bahkan data Media Partner Asia (MPA) menunjukkan Vidio berhasil menyaingi kepopuleran pemain OTT global dan regional, seperti Netflix dan Disney+, dengan menduduki posisi ke-1, baik dalam hal jumlah Pengguna Aktif Bulanan (Monthly Active Users/MAU) di kawasan Asia Tenggara maupun jumlah durasi streaming pada kuartal III/2023. Pada kuartal IV/2023, Vidio mencapai posisi platform OTT No. 1 dalam hal jumlah pelanggan terbanyak di Indonesia.

Vidio juga dikenal dengan julukan "home of sports" melalui berbagai tayangan konten olahraga lokal seperti: BRI Liga 1, Proliga, Livoli, hingga konten olahraga internasional seperti: Premier League, NBA, UEFA Champions League, Serie A, La Liga, Olimpiade, FIFA World Cup Qatar 2023 hingga yang terbaru, yaitu penyelenggaraan FIFA U-17 World Cup 2023 di mana Indonesia untuk pertama kalinya dalam sejarah ditunjuk sebagai tuan rumah.

Lalu, pada lini usaha content production, Perseroan berhasil mencapai kinerja gemilang melalui penayangan drama mini seri produksi Base Entertainment, 'Gadis Kretek', dan drama berkualitas lain yang diproduksi oleh Sinemart dan Screenplay. 'Gadis Kretek' berhasil meraih posisi No. 1 di Netflix Indonesia dan masuk dalam jajaran Top-10 di empat negara lainnya.

Perseroan berhasil menyengkkan sejumlah event yang digagas bersama RANS Entertainment dengan kapabilitas yang dimiliki internal perusahaan untuk menarik minat para pengiklan. Salah satu program kompetisi hiburan olahraga selebritas Indonesia hasil kolaborasi SCTV dan RANS yang menjadi program unggulan dan mendapat sambutan hangat dari masyarakat adalah Turnamen Olahraga Selebriti Indonesia (TOSI). Turnamen yang melibatkan selebritas papan atas Indonesia itu memainkan empat cabang olahraga, yaitu bulu tangkis, tenis, tenis meja, dan atletik. Melihat animo masyarakat yang begitu besar, TOSI kembali digelar di tahun 2024 dengan mempertandingkan cabang olahraga baru, yakni renang.

Dampak operasional Perseroan yang berkelanjutan juga dapat dirasakan pada aspek sosial, dalam bentuk penyerapan tenaga kerja dari masyarakat sekitar lokasi usaha Perseroan

distributed free set-top-boxes to the underprivileged communities as one of the commitments to sustainability in the social aspect.

The Company's strategy that continues to drive transformation is supported by continuous innovation and investment, which has successfully increased SCM's core business performance to be at the forefront of the national Free-To-Air (FTA) television lineup. Overall, in 2023, all of the Company's FTA televisions recorded an average audience share of 34.9%, with SCTV leading with an average audience share of 14.3% while Indosiar achieved an average audience share of 13.0%. Meanwhile, Mentari TV managed to place itself in fifth position in the national FTA television lineup with 7.6% average audience share. The impressive performance of our FTA TV confirms that national FTA TV remains as the viewers' favourite in the country.

Another significant achievement of SCM Group was recorded by the Vidio platform. The quality of Vidio's content and services that utilize Machine Learning Artificial Intelligence and its Original Series production has positioned it as the most popular OTT platform with more than 20 million installations on Smart TVs. In fact, Media Partner Asia (MPA) data shows that Vidio managed to rival the popularity of global and regional OTT players, such as Netflix and Disney+ by occupying the top position, both in terms of the number of Monthly Active Users (MAU) in the Southeast Asia region and the number of streaming durations in the third quarter of 2023. In the fourth quarter of 2023, Vidio became the No. 1 OTT platform in terms of the highest number of subscribers in Indonesia.

Vidio is also known as the "home of sports" through various local sports content shows such as: BRI Liga 1, Proliga, Livoli, to international sports content such as: Premier League, NBA, UEFA Champions League, Serie A, La Liga, Olympics, FIFA World Cup Qatar 2023 and most recently, the FIFA U-17 World Cup 2023 where Indonesia was appointed as the host for the first time in history.

Then, in the content production business line, the Company managed to record a brilliant performance through the airing of a mini-series drama produced by Base Entertainment, 'Gadis Kretek', and other quality dramas produced by Sinemart and Screenplay. 'Gadis Kretek' secured the No. 1 position on Netflix Indonesia and entered the Top-10 in four other countries.

The Company successfully synergized a number of events in collaboration with RANS Entertainment and its internal capabilities to attract advertisers. One of the Indonesian celebrity sports entertainment competition programs resulting from the collaboration of SCTV and RANS, which has become a flagship program and received rave reviews from the public, is the Turnamen Olahraga Selebriti Indonesia (TOSI). The tournament involves Indonesia's top celebrities to play in four sports, including badminton, tennis, table tennis, and athletics. Seeing the immense public interest, TOSI will be held again in 2024 by adding a new sport, that is swimming.

Penjelasan Direksi
Board of Directors' Message

ILM Kementerian Pemberdayaan Perempuan dan Perlindungan Anak, ILM Lembaga Sensor Film, ILM Kementerian Lingkungan Hidup dalam jumlah tayang hampir 20.000 spot dan juga dalam format Non Time Consuming (NTC) lebih dari 110.000 spot.

## MERESPONS TANTANGAN KEBERLANJUTAN

Perseroan menyadari perkembangan bisnisnya akan membuat Perseroan terekspos pada berbagai risiko usaha yang dapat menghambat upaya Perseroan untuk mewujudkan pertumbuhan yang berkelanjutan.

Perseroan dalam hal ini meyakini industri media dan hiburan akan terus bergerak dinamis di tahun-tahun mendatang seiring dengan kemajuan teknologi pendukung infrastrukturnya. Dinamika industri ini perlu diantisipasi dengan perumusan strategi yang tepat untuk memastikan prospek keberlangsungan usaha Perseroan dalam jangka panjang sebagai wujud tanggung jawabnya terhadap pemenuhan prinsip keberlanjutan dalam aspek ekonomi.

Perseroan telah melakukan investasi yang sangat besar untuk membangun infrastruktur digital dan mengadopsi teknologi terkini guna mendukung penyelenggaraan siaran televisi yang berkualitas dan produksi konten premium. Perseroan juga mengantisipasi perkembangan tren teknologi digital agar dapat senantiasa memenuhi tuntutan masyarakat yang terus berubah. Ekosistem SCM yang komprehensif dan saling melengkapi satu sama lain telah membantu Perseroan untuk beradaptasi dengan cepat terhadap berbagai risiko yang muncul dari tren perubahan pemirsa dari sebelumnya di stasiun televisi ke platform OTT atau platform media digital lainnya. Seluruh langkah yang disiapkan Perseroan tersebut diyakini akan memperkuat posisi Perseroan sebagai perusahaan media dan hiburan yang terdepan di Indonesia.

Kemudian, dinamika industri media dan hiburan juga perlu diantisipasi dengan ketersediaan sumber daya manusia yang kompeten di bidang tersebut. Dengan digitalisasi di industri media dan hiburan, kami meyakini industri ini bukan lagi sebagai sunset industry sehingga akan membuka peluang bagi penyerapan tenaga kerja yang besar ke depannya. Perkembangan media digital yang semakin pesat telah membuka peluang pertumbuhan yang cukup besar serta menjadi salah satu sumber pendapatan yang menjanjikan bagi Perseroan dan entitas anak. Dengan demikian, Perseroan telah memenuhi tanggung jawab sosialnya, terutama dalam hal pemberdayaan masyarakat.

Komitmen Perseroan dan entitas anak untuk terus mendorong transformasi digital, termasuk pada produk dan layanannya, dengan sendirinya semakin meminimalisir dampak negatif dari operasional perusahaan terhadap lingkungan, yakni dalam hal limbah yang dihasilkan dari kegiatan operasional maupun penggunaan energi karena fleksibilitas jam kerja di era digitalisasi telah memungkinkan SDM kami bekerja secara remote dan pada akhirnya berdampak positif terhadap penggunaan energi di lokasi kantor.

## PROSPEK USAHA

Indonesia akan segera memasuki tahun 2024, yang merupakan tahun politik, di mana banyak sentimen pasar yang muncul terkait proyeksi hasil Pemilu Presiden 2024. Direksi berharap pemerintah baru Indonesia ke depan dapat mewujudkan kestabilan ekonomi di dalam negeri di tengah proyeksi berlanjutnya ketidakpastian global akibat ketegangan geopolitik di berbagai belahan dunia.

## RESPONDING TO SUSTAINABILITY CHALLENGES

The Company realizes that its business development will expose it to various business risks that may hinder its efforts to realize sustainable growth.

In this case, the Company believes that the media and entertainment industry will continue to move dynamically in the coming years along with the advancement of technology that supports its infrastructure. The dynamics of this industry need to be anticipated by formulating the right strategy to ensure the Company's long-term business prospects as a form of its responsibility to fulfil the principle of sustainability in the economic aspect.

The Company has made significant investments to build digital infrastructure and adopt the latest technology to support the availability of quality television broadcasts and premium content production. The Company also anticipates the development of digital technology trends in order to meet the changing demands of society. SCM's comprehensive and complementary ecosystem has helped the Company to quickly adapt to various risks arising from the trend of viewers shifting from television stations to OTT or other digital media platforms. All the initiatives prepared by the Company are believed to strengthen the Company's position as the leading media and entertainment company in Indonesia.

Furthermore, the dynamics of the media and entertainment industry also need to be anticipated with the availability of competent human resources in this industry. With the digitalization of the media and entertainment industry, we believe that this industry is no longer a sunset industry so that it will open up opportunities for large employment in the future. The rapid development of digital media has opened up considerable growth opportunities and become one of the promising sources of income for the Company and its subsidiaries. Thus, the Company has fulfilled its social responsibility, especially in terms of community empowerment.

The commitment of the Company and its subsidiaries to continue encouraging digital transformation, including in its products and services, will naturally minimize the negative impact of the Company's operations on the environment, particularly in terms of waste generated from operational activities and energy usage due to the flexibility of working hours in the era of digitalization that allows our Human Resources to work remotely and consequently has a positive impact on energy usage at office locations.

## BUSINESS PROSPECT

Indonesia will soon enter a political year in 2024, resulting in a lot of market sentiment in relation to the projected outcome of the 2024 Presidential Election. The Board of Directors hopes that Indonesia's new government will be able to realize economic stability in the country amidst the projection of continued global uncertainty due to geopolitical tensions in various parts of the world.

Terutama dalam kaitannya dengan industri media dan hiburan, Direksi berkomitmen untuk mengembangkan kapabilitas entitas anak yang tergabung dalam ekosistem Grup SCM dalam rangka membentuk keunggulan kompetitif sebagai satu grup media dan hiburan yang terkemuka di Indonesia dan pada akhirnya masing-masing entitas anak dapat meningkatkan skala bisnisnya.

Dengan dinamika yang terjadi di industri media serta perkembangan teknologi digital, Perseroan akan terus berinvestasi pada infrastruktur pendukung dan membangun lingkungan kerja yang mendorong budaya inovasi dan kreatifitas agar melahirkan program atau konten yang menarik dan berkualitas untuk mempertahankan kinerja Grup kami di tengah penetrasi yang kuat dari pemain global maupun regional.

## PENUTUP

Pencapaian kinerja keberlanjutan Perseroan tentunya membutuhkan dukungan besar dari seluruh pemangku kepentingan. Untuk itu, kami ingin menyampaikan terima kasih kepada Dewan Komisaris atas rekomendasi dan arahan yang diberikan, dan kepada seluruh karyawan atas kontribusinya terhadap pencapaian yang baik di tahun 2023. Besar harapan kami bahwa kerja sama yang terjalin baik selama ini akan memampukan Perseroan untuk melaksanakan seluruh agenda korporasi dan mengantisipasi tantangan bersama di masa yang akan datang.

Selain itu, kami juga berharap dapat terus memberikan manfaat yang positif kepada para pemangku kepentingan dan menjaga prospek keberlanjutan perusahaan melalui peningkatan kontribusi perusahaan terhadap aspek ekonomi, sosial, maupun lingkungan.

Especially in relation to the media and entertainment industry, the Board of Directors is committed to developing the capabilities of the subsidiaries within SCM Group's ecosystem in order to establish a competitive advantage as one of the leading media and entertainment groups in Indonesia and to enable each subsidiary to increase the scale of their business.

Given the dynamics in the media industry and the development of digital technology, the Company will continue to invest in supporting infrastructure and build a work environment that encourages a culture of innovation and creativity in order to produce attractive and quality programs or content to sustain our Group's performance amidst strong penetration from global and regional players.

## CLOSING

The Company's sustainability performance certainly requires great support from all stakeholders. Therefore, we would like to express our gratitude to the Board of Commissioners for their recommendations and guidance, and to all employees for their contributions to a successful achievement in 2023. We sincerely hope that the cooperation we have built over the years will enable us to execute our corporate agenda and anticipate common challenges in the future.

In addition, we also hope to continue providing positive benefits to stakeholders and maintaining the Company's sustainability prospects by increasing our contribution to economic, social, and environmental aspects.

Hormat kami,
Sincerely,

SUTANTO HARTONO
Direktur Utama/President Director

## SCM IN BRIEF

[GRI 2-1]

Selama 25 tahun, Perseroan telah membangun reputasi sebagai perusahaan media dan hiburan yang terkemuka di Indonesia dengan total audience share dari tiga stasiun televisi Free-to-Air nasional yang dimilikinya mencapai 34,9% per 31 Desember 2023. Perseroan senantiasa mengikuti perkembangan industri media dan hiburan yang sangat dinamis dengan didukung oleh teknologi maju dan infrastruktur digital yang dimilikinya. Perseroan juga terus bertransformasi agar dapat meningkatkan kualitas program, konten, tayangan, dan layanan di bidang media. Ekspansi bisnis SCM memposisikannya menjadi salah satu penyedia konten berkualitas dan jasa periklanan, manajemen artis, serta manajemen fasilitas siaran dan produksi film yang terkemuka.

For 25 years, the Company has built a reputation as a leading media and entertainment company in Indonesia with a combined audience share of its three national Free-to-Air television stations reaching 34.9% as of December 31, 2023. The Company keeps up with the dynamic development of the media and entertainment industry with the support of its advanced technology and digital infrastructure. The Company also continues to transform in order to improve the quality of its media programs, content, broadcasts and services. SCM's business expansion has positioned itself as one of the leading providers of quality content and advertising services provider of quality contents and advertising services, artist management, as well as broadcasting facility management and a leading film producer.

# Empowering industries with agentic AI

![img-64.jpeg](img-64.jpeg)

"Multi-agent working represents a significant advancement in AI technology, and we believe there are limitless possibilities for its long-term application. Morpheus brings new ways of solving complex industry challenges, optimising processes and delivering unprecedented value to businesses and their customers."

Matt Cloke

Chief Technology Officer

AI is an exciting technology which will positively impact our clients and businesses.

In April 2024, we announced the creation of our Agentic AI Industry Accelerator, internally designated as 'Morpheus.' The first of its kind, the accelerator and its AI-powered industry tools combine the power of data and multi-agent working to tackle complex challenges across all industries, including highly regulated fields like healthcare, insurance, financial services and private equity.

Large language models (LLMs) and AI have existed in a 'black box' with little insight into how the systems arrive at the answers they provide. Endava is changing this by operationalising LLMs around data to overcome common barriers caused by hallucinations, ensuring that all activity is transparent, knowable and auditable.

Throughout regulated industries, Endava's agentic accelerator can deliver value in countless ways, such as helping insurers more efficiently underwrite policies, working with analysts on legal or financial research and due diligence or driving the development and testing of new healthcare products.

Morpheus represents the first significant step in applying advanced language model operations to automate complex processes within industries with strict regulatory requirements or data transparency needs. The heart of the design is based on three foundational themes:

Data at the core with full transparency
- Teams of agents to break down complex workflows
- Dynamic scaling of teams to accelerate processes

Lead AI agents distribute the workload amongst a team of specialist agents, collating their results and orchestrating the next workflow steps while capturing data for traceability and governance at every step. LLM—and cloud-agnostic, Endava's AI accelerator is a flexible way to rapidly transform businesses across any industry.

Creating data products in this way enables a new avenue of thinking about autonomous teams, removing constraints and freeing up entire workforces to perform more meaningful work.

# Healthcare

## ER triage agent

During a hackathon organised by Endava and Microsoft, we were challenged to develop a prototype for an Emergency Room (ER) Triage Agent. The goal was to build a chatbot-like application to guide patients through the triage process in the healthcare industry. In this application, patients are asked a series of questions to assess the severity of their medical condition. The patients are then prioritised accordingly.

The chatbot solution utilises Semantic Kernel from Microsoft Azure Open AI large language model and implements an Azure Chat Completion pattern. It uses a system prompt to adapt the large language model's answers to the triage agent's function. Depending on the severity of the medical condition, the agent is tasked to ask a series of questions to obtain more detailed information on the patient's condition. The system is programmed with predefined cases with verified diagnoses and triage severity levels to receive a correct output calibration, and the patients are then ranked in order of severity.

## Wealth management

## Personalised news recommendations

As part of an AI-native wealth management platform, we built a personalised news recommendation engine tailored to client portfolios. Financial advisors spend an average of 15% of their working day completing client market research. Our solution pulls information relevant to each client's portfolio and provides the adviser with key talking points. This tool helps free up advisers to focus on non-routine work.

News searches are performed using a combination of semantic and fuzzy keyword searches, leveraging OpenAI embeddings, the extended LlamaIndex framework and Elasticsearch's native fuzzy search capability. News summaries, as well as key talking points, are generated using OpenAI GPT-4. We also provide financial advisers with semantic search-based chat capability, allowing them to ask additional questions regarding the news stories. Guardrails and moderation capability protect interactions to help enhance security and compliance.

## Real estate

## AI augmented search for real estate platform

To enhance the overall customer experience and perform more targeted searches for real estate buyers, we developed a solution empowering potential buyers to conduct interactive searches using natural human language. Potential buyers can describe their ideal property parameters, then OpenAI capabilities seamlessly translate the free-text input and retrieve matching properties. This approach eliminates the need to access traditional individual brokers' websites.
